(p2, 2p(1 − p), (1 − p)2) = (0 .09, 0.42, 0.49).

pages.title: Neutral fixation probability
pages.text:
Neutral ﬁxation probability
For a ﬁnite neutral chain, absorption occurs with probability one.
Pr(p∞ = 1) = E[p∞] = p0.
Fixation does not require a selective advantage.
Mathematical Modeling Notes 17 / 19

pages.text:
Computational checks for a random model
Check integer counts, the 1/(2N ) frequency grid, bounds, and absorbing states.
Compare repeated-draw moments with theoretical moments using sampling uncertainty.
A seed controls repeatability, not representativeness.
